questions: Did a function, class, route, response, config key or database column that other code or other apps may rely on change its name, inputs or shape? Callers are not in the diff, so ask this as a question for the author.
Did a returned object or JSON response change shape, for example a field renamed, moved inside another object or removed? Apps that read the old field will get nothing.
Was something renamed or removed without keeping the old name working for a while?

hints.title: Exported {1} removed or renamed
hints.why: Other files or projects that import {1} will break when this merges.
hints.fix: Search for every use of {1} and update it, or keep the old name working for a while.
hints.comment: {1} is removed or renamed here. Is anything else still importing it?

hints.title: Route {1} removed or changed
hints.why: Apps or pages that call {1} will start getting errors.
hints.fix: Keep the old route working (or redirect it) until everything that calls it is updated.
hints.comment: The route {1} goes away in this PR. Does anything still call it?

hints.title: Inputs of {1} changed
hints.why: Code that calls {1} the old way may now pass the wrong values, or fail.
hints.fix: Check every call of {1}, or give new inputs a default so old calls still work.
hints.comment: The inputs of {1} changed. Have all the places that call it been updated?
